excerpt.zh: 我们接收到这颗气态巨行星的大气内发射出来的微弱信号。可能是什么人，或者是什么东西正在试图建立联系？
excerpt.en: We are picking up what may be a faint transmission coming from somewhere deep inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. Could someone - or something - be trying to communicate?

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]从[From.GetName]检测到了一些有趣的读数。那颗气态巨行星的大气层中有高剂量的辐射，似乎是由密集的轨道轰炸引起的。至于为什么有人要这么做则是个谜。

就在[Root.GetName]准备离开轨道时，科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]从行星内部检测到了一个微弱的信号。或许是某种通讯信号，但行星的背景辐射太强，很难将信号从背景噪声中分离出来。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has picked up some curious readings from [From.GetName]. There are significant pockets of radiation in the gas giant's atmosphere that appear to be the result of intense orbital bombardment. What someone could hope to gain by bombing a gas giant from orbit remains a mystery however.

As the [Root.GetName] was preparing to break orbit, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] discovered a weak signal coming from the planet's interior. It may be a transmission of some kind, but the gas giant's background radiation makes it difficult to isolate.

label.zh: 我们应该调查这个信号。
探测器误差而已。无视它吧。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗气态巨行星的名称。
note.en: In the game, this gas giant's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位科学家的称谓。
note.en: In the game, the name of this scientist appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这艘舰船的名称。
note.en: In the game, the ship's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我们从气态巨行星[From.GetName]的内部收到了一个微弱的信号。这可能是某种通讯，但我们尚未将信号分离出来。
texts.en: We have picked up a weak signal coming from the interior of the gas giant [From.GetName]. It may be a transmission of some kind, but we have not yet been able to isolate the signal.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗气态巨行星的名称。
note.en: In the game, this gas giant's name appears here.

texts.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]设法从[From.From.From.GetName]的大气层深处分离出了该信号。这确实是某种通讯联络，我们也借助滤波软件将其过滤了出来。
texts.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has managed to isolate the weak signal that was coming from somewhere deep inside the atmosphere of [From.From.From.GetName]. It does indeed appear to be a transmission, and we have filtered it through our translation software.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, that planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现科学官的名字。
note.en: In the game, the science officer's name appears here.

texts.zh: 终于见面了，旅行者！我们是达斯纳克，你正在绕行的这颗星球叫托洛克·隆-是我们先祖的家园。见到其他种群总是很振奋人心的，即使我们之间的上次见面……并不怎么顺利。你肯定检测到了我们大气散发出的辐射。托洛克·隆已经奄奄一息了，如果没有其他的栖身之所的话，我们的种群就会消灭。我们已经找好了自己的下一个家园，但没有办法到达那里。可惜的是，我们的无形特征意味着并没有太多工业或科技。你能帮助我们吗？
texts.en:
Finally! Well met, spacefarer! We are the Dathnak, and the planet you are orbiting is Tollok Rong - our ancestral home. It is always riveting to meet a solid, even if our last encounter with your kind was somewhat... problematic.

You have no doubt detected the radiation surges coming from our atmosphere. Tollok Rong is dying, and our species will perish unless we find a new home. We have identified a planet that would suit our physiology, but we have no means to get there. Sadly, our non-corporeal nature means we don't have much in the way of industry or technology. Will you help us?

label.zh: 既然没有科技，那你怎么能和我们对话？
label.en: If you have no technology, how are we speaking?

responses.zh: 这个嘛，毕竟你们不是我们遇到的第一个客人。某个慷慨的种群在290万个太阳年之前送了我们一些亚空间通讯器和一个扫描阵列。他们已经将其改造得符合我们的生理特征了。算是遇到你们这类人的其中一个好处。
responses.en:
Ah, but you are not the first solid to pay us a visit! Another spacefarer graciously donated a small subspace transmitter and a scanner array to us 2.9 million solar cycles ago. They had been designed to be compatible with our physiology.

One of the more positive encounters we've had with your kind.

responses.zh: 嗯，我们和几千年前来的人之间发生了一些不愉快，他们想让我们信奉他们的信念，我们拒绝了，于是他们就想灭了我们。事先也不通知一声！趁我们不注意，他们将舰队开进了我们的轨道上空，对我们进行狂轰滥炸。
responses.en:
Well, the last time solids visited us a few thousand cycles ago, things didn't go very well. They wanted us to embrace their religion, we refused and this triggered some kind of genocidal reaction.

Completely unwarranted! Before we knew what was happening, they maneuvered their fleet into orbit and unleashed a massive bombardment.

label.zh: 你想请我们把全帝国的人民都转移到别的星球？
label.en: You want us to transport your entire species to another planet?

responses.zh: 是的！并且希望马上就办！别担心，我们人其实也不是太多。许多达斯纳克都死在了那次轰炸中了，活下来的就退到了大气层的更深处。这里与地表的沟通不是特别顺畅，而且辐射也正在扩散。我们没多少时间了！
responses.en: Yes! And hopefully soon! Don't worry, there aren't too many of us. Most Dathnak died when our planet was bombarded, and those who survived retreated deeper into the atmosphere. Communication with the surface is difficult here, and the radiation is spreading. We don't have much time!

responses.zh: 太好了！我就知道你们靠谱。我们的新家坐标已经发给你们啦。你必须向我保证不能抢先一步先把那地方给占了，无论那地方有多好！
responses.en:
Excellent! I knew we could count on you. The coordinates of our new home have been forwarded.

You must promise not to let your own colonists claim this alluring world before we get there, no matter how strong the temptation!

label.en: Sorry. It would be too much of a hassle.

responses.zh:
我就知道！我早就告诉过其他人这些固体家伙都是毫无人性的混蛋，他们就是不信！

你们这群人啊——简直就是星系的瘟疫！总有一天我们会夺取你们的地位，到时候再跟你们算账。记住我的话吧。固体的时代已经结束了！气态生命的时代将会来临！
responses.en:
I knew it! I warned the others that solids are incapable of feeling compassion, but they insisted on making this humiliating plea.

I know you for what you are - a plague on this galaxy! One day it will be inherited by beings such as us, and there shall be a reckoning. Mark my words. The age of solids will be over! The time of the gaseous life form shall come!

texts.zh: 我们已经同意将达斯纳克人从它们即将要毁灭的母星转移至气态巨行星[baldarak_planet.GetName]。在那里它们将会建立新的家园。时间紧迫。
texts.en: We have agreed to transport the Dathnak from their doomed homeworld to the gas giant [baldarak_planet.GetName], where they will make a new home. Time is short.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那颗气态巨行星的名称。
note.en: In the game, that gas giant's name appears here.

texts.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]全程监督了达斯纳克的搬家之旅。一列配备着大型高气压槽的民用货舰载着那些气态生物横穿天际，将他们送往了气态巨行星的大气层。还顺带捎上了扫描阵列和古老通讯器。
texts.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has finished supervising the relocation of the Dathnak to their new home. A convoy of civilian freighters equipped with massive pressurized gas tanks ferried the gaseous beings across space and deposited them into the gas giant's atmosphere. Their ancient transmitter and scanner array were also brought along.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现科学官的名字。
note.en: In the game, the science officer's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我们永远欠你一份情！这颗星球比我们想象的更好。人生头一次啊，我们的后代可以在大气层中玩耍嬉戏而不必担心自己的生命安全。我们决定以你的种群来命名我们的新家，伯达拉克。达斯纳克的后人会永远记住我们的救世主！
texts.en:
We are forever in your debt! This planet has exceeded our expectations. For the first time in generations, our young can frolic in the upper atmosphere without starting to glow.

We have decided to call our new home Baldarak after your species. Future generations of Dathnak shall always know the name of their saviors!

responses.zh: 这样啊？那真是……太尴尬了，但你们这些固体家伙真是长的太像了。恐怕现在改名字也来不及了……这个名字也挺好听的嘛！
responses.en: Really? I could have sworn... apologies, but it can be difficult to tell you solids apart. I'm afraid it's too late to change the name now. It has a nice ring to it, though, don't you think?

label.zh: 伯达拉克？真是个好名字！
label.en: Baldarak? That is an excellent name!

responses.zh: 这个名字真的很好听，不是吗？能被你们这些名字听起来如此美妙的固体家伙们拯救是我们的幸运啊！
responses.en: It has such a nice ring to it, doesn't it? We're quite lucky to have been rescued by such phonetically pleasing solids!

label.en: Good luck with your new home.

responses.zh: 再次感谢，亲爱的朋友！愿气流保你永不坠落。
responses.en: Thank you again, dear friends! May the atmospheric currents always keep you aloft!

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个物种的名称。
note.en: In the game, the species' name appears here.

texts.zh: 托洛克·隆的环境进一步恶化，我们已经无法拯救那些达斯纳克了。辐射扩散到了大部分的大气层，达斯纳克幸存者不得不撤退到离核心更近的地方，而那里的通讯条件相当的差。辐射最终会扩散到那里的，那些达斯纳克只能听天由命了。
texts.en: The conditions on Tollok Rong have deteriorated to the point where the Dathnak can no longer be saved. The radiation has spread across most of the atmosphere, and the Dathnak survivors have retreated even deeper towards the planet's core where communication with the surface is no longer possible. Eventually the radiation will finds its way there as well, rendering their species extinct.

texts.zh: 气态巨行星[From.From.From.GetName]内部的信号消失了。我们再也不清楚它来自何方了。
texts.en: The weak signal we picked up coming from the interior of the gas giant [From.From.From.GetName] has faded. We shall never learn of its origin.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那颗气态巨行星的名称。
note.en: In the game, that gas giant's name appears here.

summary.text:
# 气态巨行星信号 / Gas Giant Signal

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/00_anomaly_categories.txt:710; events/anomaly_events_4.txt:10 (anomaly.5000); common/special_projects/00_projects_1.txt (GAS_GIANT_SIGNAL); events/anomaly_events_4.txt:42 (anomaly.5001); events/anomaly_events_4.txt:72 (anomaly.5002); events/anomaly_events_4.txt:93 (anomaly.5003); common/special_projects/00_projects_1.txt (GAS_GIANT_RELOCATION); events/anomaly_events_4.txt:160 (anomaly.5004); events/anomaly_events_4.txt:202 (anomaly.5005); events/anomaly_events_4.txt:223 (anomaly.5006)

## 如何开始 How it starts

气态巨行星可能生成（5级，权重1，全局一次 max_once_global）。

Can spawn on a gas giant (level 5, weight 1, once globally via max_once_global).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 anomaly.5000“气态巨行星信号”：给行星打上 tollok_rong 标志；选项a启用项目 GAS_GIANT_SIGNAL“分离信号”（180天，限时1080天，科学船+科学家）；选项b放弃。项目完成 → anomaly.5001（30天后 story.6 报告，行星改名“托洛克·荣”），“接入”后进入 anomaly.5003“气态巨行星传输信号”（对话：a-c 只显示回应，e 结束；d 选定最近的一颗无主或自己的气态巨行星为“巴尔达拉克”，并启用项目 GAS_GIANT_RELOCATION“转移达斯纳克”，180天，限时1080天）。转移完成 → anomaly.5004（该行星改名“巴尔达拉克”、获得 gas_giant_civ 修正与 d_society_5 矿藏）→ anomaly.5006“信号传输接入”（设置 baldarak_settled，标本 dathnak_gas，对话）。两个项目超时（1080天）分别触发 anomaly.5002 / anomaly.5005“特殊项目失败”。

Single result anomaly.5000 "Gas Giant Signal": flags the planet tollok_rong; option a enables project GAS_GIANT_SIGNAL "Isolate Signal" (180 days, 1080-day limit, science ship and scientist); option b walks away. Project complete → anomaly.5001 (a story.6 report 30 days later; the planet is renamed Tollok Rong) and, once connected, anomaly.5003 "Gas Giant Transmission" (a dialogue: a-c only show replies, e ends; d marks the nearest unowned or own gas giant as 'Baldarak' and enables project GAS_GIANT_RELOCATION "Dathnak Relocation", 180 days, 1080-day limit). Relocation complete → anomaly.5004 (the planet is renamed Baldarak, gets the gas_giant_civ modifier and a d_society_5 deposit) → anomaly.5006 "Incoming Transmission" (sets baldarak_settled, specimen dathnak_gas, a dialogue). Each project that times out (1080 days) fires anomaly.5002 / anomaly.5005 "Special Project Failed".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

5000 的a/b二选一；每个项目要么按时完成要么超时失败（失败事件只有一个“不幸”选项）。5003 的对话选项中只有 d 会推进到转移项目。

5000's options a/b are alternatives; each project either completes in time or fails on timeout (the failure events have a single 'Unfortunate' option). In 5003's dialogue only d advances to the relocation project.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

anomaly.5006 的选项a按所有者是否为巴尔达拉克物种变化。

anomaly.5006's option a depends on whether the owner is of the Baldarak species.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常、anomaly.5000–5006、两个项目；编译树正确，无需改动。

Checked the anomaly, anomaly.5000-5006 and both projects; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed.
